claim: Digital Soil Mapping commonly uses environmental covariates such as terrain, climate, remote sensing and soil/landscape information, but their usefulness must be validated for each target property and study area.
conditions: Applies when covariates such as PCs, DEM-derived variables, NDVI or climate layers are used to predict soil properties.
limitations: Covariate relevance depends on soil-forming factors, scale, preprocessing, temporal mismatch, and the target indicator.
recommended_action: Report regression strength and compare RK against regression-only and OK to verify whether covariates help.
not_allowed_action: Do not assume PC or remote sensing covariates improve prediction without validation evidence.
